-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2c-T2: a token that hides a comment
-- opener. The atom `rvV2cTok/-` contains `/-`, so a reader stripping comments
-- would mis-parse a source that used it, and it also ends in `-`. Rule 2 of
-- addendum V2c refuses it as non-inert.
syntax "rvV2cTok/-" : term
